# Swiss QC Guru

> Swiss QC Guru by NuNu Soft is a desktop app for Windows and Mac that checks a finished transmission master against the delivery specs of ARD, ZDF, ORF and SRF (EBU R 103, EBU R 128) before it is delivered. Every finding has a timecode, a frame and the line of the spec it breaks. One-time price: EUR 199 (CHF 179, USD 239). Free trial: checks the whole file and shows half of the findings. Current version: 0.2.10 (7 November 2026). New: build a repaired version per broadcaster from the multi-template result. New: check one file against several broadcaster templates at once (matrix of verdicts, template groups). Every pack shows the date its templates were last updated.

## Key facts

- Product: Swiss QC Guru – file-based technical QC before delivery to a broadcaster; app with player and report, plus a command line `qccheck`
- Maker: NuNu Soft, Zürich, Switzerland – support@vannuffel.ch
- Requires: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) or macOS 12 or later on Apple Silicon or Intel; about 500 MB disk; brings its own ffmpeg (GPL, with x264; source offer in the package)
- Install: one line in PowerShell or Terminal, no administrator rights; packages are Ed25519-signed and checked before they are unpacked; updates install themselves
- Broadcaster templates built in: ARD / ZDF / ORF (TPR 2025, XDCAM HD422 MXF), ZDF (AVC-Intra 100 MXF), ZDF ProRes 422 HQ, ORF, SRF, EBU generic (R 103 / R 128, HD and UHD); own templates by duplicating one and changing thresholds and severities
- Add-on Online & Podcast (needs the app licence): templates for YouTube, Spotify video, Apple Podcasts (−16 LKFS ±1, true peak −1 dBFS) and Instagram / TikTok (portrait 1080×1920), plus social ad templates for Meta (Facebook/Instagram feed, Stories, Reels), TikTok In-Feed, YouTube (skippable, non-skippable 15–60 s, bumper 5–6 s) and LinkedIn (MP4, up to 30 fps, 3 s–30 min); checks faststart, edit lists, variable frame rate, start offset, keyframe interval, portrait vs landscape; repair keeps AAC and rewraps with faststart
- Included in every licence: commercial templates for ARD Media, ZDF Werbefernsehen, ORF-Enterprise and admeira (SRG) with frame-accurate spot length, black frames at start and end and short-form loudness
- Add-ons (each needs the app licence; every pack also has commercial/spot templates where the broadcaster or platform publishes an ad spec with frame-accurate length, black frames and short-form loudness): United Kingdom & Ireland (AS-11 UK DPP: BBC, ITV, Channel 4, Channel 5, Sky HD/UHD, STV; Ireland: RTÉ, Virgin Media Television, TG4), France (CST-RT-040: France Télévisions, TF1, CANAL+, ARTE), Spain & Portugal (loudness law RD 250/2025, CNMC commercials, Mediaset España HD/UHD SDR and HDR10, RTVE, Canal Sur, Televisión Canaria, Aragón TV; Portugal ERC loudness and RTP commercials), Italy (AGCOM, RAI HD commercials, institutional spots, Mediaset / Publitalia ’80, spot delivery via Extreme Reach and Cape), Benelux (Screenforce commercials for Ster, Ad Alliance and Talpa, DigitalDeli online video, Talpa and NPO / AVROTROS programmes, VRT, Belgian commercials via Slingshot, IP Luxembourg), Nordics (SVT, NRK, DR, Yle, TV 2 Danmark, TV 2 Norway), Germany, Austria & Switzerland private (ProSiebenSat.1, PULS 4 / ATV, RTL, ServusTV; commercials for Sky Deutschland, CH Media and the Swiss ad windows via Goldbach), United States (ATSC A/85 base, FOX, PBS, A+E, Warner Bros. Discovery, Paramount, Hallmark, Hulu; checks closed captions, drop-frame timecode, black between acts, AFD), Amazon MGM Studios (production masters HD/UHD SDR and UHD HDR per the Asset Technical Specifications, −27 LKFS ±2, true peak −2 dBTP), Netflix (ProRes masters HD/UHD, MP4 for creator/podcast titles, Netflix Ads pre-roll and mid-roll, IMF App 2E originals: JPEG 2000 level of every frame, Dolby Vision L1, language versions; BWAV ADM sound mixes 5.1/Atmos with Netflix group labels), Czech Republic/Slovakia/Poland (ČT, TV Nova, Prima, Barrandov, JOJ, TVP, Polsat, TVN), Hungary and Lithuania (MTVA, RTL Magyarország via Adstream and Honeycomb, LNK), Balkans & Greece (HRT, RTV Slovenija, TV Pink, RTCG, ERT), Canada (CBC and Radio-Canada HD/UHD and commercials, Bell Media incl. Noovo and RDS, Corus / Global, Télé-Québec, AMI-télé, CRTC commercials per ATSC A/85), Middle East, Turkey & Africa (SABC, SBC Seychelles, Turkish RTÜK loudness directive; MENA and South African commercials per a delivery service, marked unconfirmed), Australia and New Zealand (Free TV OP-59/OP-29/OP-52, Network 10, TVNZ), Japan (JBA CM standard 2023, T035 programme exchange: 59.94i drop-frame, CM start on a whole hour, loudness at most −24.0 LKFS), Asia-Pacific (Doordarshan, Indian commercials, TVB, ViuTV, Mediacorp, loudness law South Korea and China), Latin America (Brazil Portaria 354 and EBC, Argentina, Chile CNTV, Colombia, Mexico IFT-013, Uruguay; peak levels in dBFS), Apple TV (film and TV masters for the Apple TV store per the Video and Audio Asset Guide: HD, 4K, HDR source file with Dolby Vision sidecar XML)
- Add-on prices: country and platform packs EUR 99 (CHF 89, USD 119) or EUR 149 (CHF 139, USD 179) each; Online & Podcast EUR 49 (CHF 45, USD 59); Cinema EUR 199 (CHF 179, USD 239)
- Complete: the licence and all packs including future ones, plus PodcastMagic 360 – EUR 1,299 (CHF 1,199, USD 1,549)
- Company licences and several workstations: on request, support@vannuffel.ch
- Add-on Cinema (DCP), EUR 199: checks Digital Cinema Packages per DCI (SMPTE or Interop structure, ASSETMAP/PKL/CPL, SHA-1 hashes and sizes, ISDCF name, encryption, 2K/4K flat/scope/full, frame rate, bit rate up to 250 Mbit/s, 24-bit PCM sound, JPEG 2000 profile and size of every frame, black and freeze frames across reels) plus Leq(m) per ISO 21727 for trailers (TASA, 85) and cinema ads (82: DCM UK, Pearl & Dean Ireland, Weischer.Cinema Germany and Switzerland) and the DCP specs of Berlinale, Cannes, Venice, Visions du Réel and Sundance; encrypted DCPs are checked for structure and hashes only
- Checks (41, full list: https://swissqcguru.com/broadcasters.html#checks-all): container and metadata (MXF OP1a, header Closed and Complete, codec, bit rate, colour tag 1-1-1, track layout, start timecode), levels and gamut (luma, RGB, chroma per frame, small areas separately, illegal codes, TRS), loudness and audio (integrated loudness, true peak, LRA per track pair, short-term and momentary limits, sample peak in dBFS for specs without LUFS, asymmetric loudness window, clipping, phase, silence, required silence at the programme edges, missing audio, Dolby E), programme start on a whole hour (Japan), drop-frame timecode, black, freeze frames, repeated frames and cadence, interlace against flag and format, bars and borders, pixel defects, banding, a hint on possible flashes (not a certified Harding test), timecode continuity, burnt-in timecode against container timecode, colour bars and line-up tone
- Input formats: XDCAM HD422, AVC-Intra, ProRes, DNxHD/HR, JPEG 2000, H.264/HEVC, uncompressed; MXF, MOV, MP4, MKV; audio PCM, AAC, AC-3, Dolby E is recognised
- Thresholds carry their source in the spec; where a spec does not state a value it is marked "unconfirmed". Every template is checked regularly against its published source and updated with the app updates; a missing broadcaster or platform can be requested by sending its delivery spec to support@vannuffel.ch
- Verdicts: Passed, Passed with warnings, Failed, Incomplete
- Player: every checked file opens in the built-in player – the whole master with picture and programme sound, frame by frame, without opening the edit (MXF and ProRes via a playback copy made in the background); frame-accurate timeline with markers per lane, waveform, vectorscope, RGB parade, safe areas, zebra and false colour at the template's limits, single fields, J K L shuttle up to 8×; accept an intentional finding with a note
- Output: HTML and PDF report, delivery package (report, PDF, checksums, summary, client view MP4 with Rec.709 → desktop look), markers for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro or CSV, repair as a new file (loudness, start timecode, levels, rewrap, or a re-encode to AVC-Intra 100, XAVC, XDCAM HD422 or H.264, 50p to real 50i), template editor, rules that pick the template by file name, folder or format, watch folders
- Price: EUR 199 (CHF 179, USD 239) once, licence for one computer at a time (movable), all 1.x updates; sold through Polar (merchant of record)
- Free trial: no key; all checks on the whole file, half of the findings shown (the most serious one always), the others listed as locked with their severity only; delivery package, PDF, markers, repair and watch folder need the licence
- Privacy: all checks run locally; files are never uploaded; the internet is used for updates, to confirm the licence (works up to 30 days offline) and, only with consent, an anonymous once-a-day usage count
- Not a replacement for the broadcaster's acceptance – a technical pre-check
- Languages: English, German
